summary: ISO 8601 duration support for ms: formatISO is built and committed, and parseISO, its inverse, is now added. Both are exported from src/index.ts. No PR or release is recorded yet.
narrative: The owner asked for ISO 8601 duration support in ms, starting with formatting. Days are the largest unit because months and years are ambiguous. formatISO was added with tests at 100% coverage and committed as bcd0d52. Its regex trailing-zero strip was replaced with a loop, because the owner said Leo from security wants no regular expressions in new parsing code on this branch after the ReDoS advisory. In a later conversation the owner asked for parseISO, the inverse of formatISO. The agent added it, handling days, hours, minutes and fractional seconds, and returning NaN for unsupported input. Memory shows no commit, PR, merge or release for parseISO yet.
